objective.title: Qualify parser overflow hardening and explicit catalogue resolution

declared.summary: Observe three independent prechange parser boundary REDs, reject integer dimension exponent overflows through typed results, install a culture-independent explicit-profile bridge from the full inherited Math unit catalog, and qualify eight exact boundary oracles plus all regressions to complete M1-W02-C02.
declared.value: Makes dw.quantities.expression a usable standalone bounded exact evaluator with safe dimension arithmetic, typed refusal rather than unhandled overflow, and injectable deterministic unit semantics across the 58-unit inherited catalogue.
debtChanges: OverflowException is mapped at the public parser boundary to MagnitudeLimit with position zero; precise operator-level positions remain an optional later refinement, not a claim of this run.
Accepted character/token/depth/power/number limits are defended by targeted tests; these are not a universal CPU/memory or cryptographic resource guarantee for arbitrary expressions.
The bridge requires an explicit UnitSystem for ambiguous tokens; it never emulates AURA's implicit culture-priority decision and does not modify any sibling repository.
declared.nextAction: Refine M1-W02-C03 selection and error taxonomy on the integrated exact grammar, then qualify the remaining unit-expression functional slice without reopening completed C01/C02 contracts.

achievements.achievement: Three focused pre-change REDs observe unchecked exponent multiplication, leaked public dimension overflow and the absent explicit-profile expression bridge; the original parser SHA and source evidence are verified before mutation.

All eight dimension exponents are scaled using checked arithmetic, public Evaluate catches overflows as typed MagnitudeLimit, and a public injected resolver bridges the inherited or strict Math catalog with explicit profiles only, updating the locked standalone project graph.

Three REDs turn green and eight independent bridge/boundary oracles pass, including ambiguous cups, exact inch/IEC conversions, culture independence, typed unsafe syntax and negative-power overflows, together with full quantities, locked solution and foundation regressions.

Expression parser boundary and unit integration contracts are completed from observed RED through checked implementation and focused qualification, with unsupported host policies and resource limits explicitly recorded.

The bounded exact grammar chunk is complete: SHA-pinned parser transfer and independent exact arithmetic/rational-root tests, checked dimension overflow and typed failures, public grammar resource limits, deterministic explicit-profile catalog resolution, and regression evidence.
